purpose: Teach: 長期間/しまわ/すんなり/売り切れ/兆し/区切り/近日/工具

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: このプロジェクト、長期間、慎重に進めろ。
lines.en: This project needs careful, long-term handling. Move deliberately.
lines.style: Measured authority. Each phrase lands with weight. No rush. The tone of someone accustomed to being heard the first time.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。重要書類、しまわないと、不安です。
lines.en: Understood. I want to make sure all the critical documents are properly stored and secured.
lines.style: Earnest, slightly self-conscious. A touch apologetic for wanting to do things right. Even cadence—he's thinking as he speaks.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 契約、すんなりまとまったのは、君の手柄だ。
lines.en: The contract came together smoothly. That was your work.
lines.style: Direct acknowledgment, genuinely warm. Not effusive—a superior offering earned recognition. Steady eye contact in the voice.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。商品、売り切れ、続出しております。
lines.en: Yes. The products keep selling out. It's been happening consistently.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact report, barely concealing quiet pride. The tone of someone sharing good news by just stating facts.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 業績、回復の兆し、感じるな、最近。
lines.en: I can feel the business starting to recover lately.
lines.style: Reflective, almost to himself but addressed to Kenji. Thoughtful pause weight. The tone of someone who sees patterns others miss.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。年度の区切り、近日、お祝い予定です。
lines.en: The fiscal year is wrapping up soon. We're planning a small celebration.
lines.style: Lighter now, a hint of warmth breaking through. Still measured, but the news is good and it shows in the pace.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 新商品、近日発売、宣伝、強化しろ。
lines.en: The new product launches soon. I want the advertising campaign intensified.
lines.style: Directive but not harsh. Clear expectation. The authority is in the simplicity—he knows it will get done.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。工場の工具、点検、来週実施します。
lines.en: Understood. We'll conduct a full inspection of the factory equipment next week.
lines.style: Confirmatory, ready to act. Kenji is closing the meeting. Brief, professional, but underneath—the confidence of someone who knows what needs doing.
